title: Mexican Pasta Bake
description: A quick and easy pasta bake recipe inspired by Mexican flavors. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Paccheri pasta
ingredients.notes: Any pasta shape will work, but paccheri is recommended for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Quick taco seasoning
ingredients.notes: You can use store-bought taco seasoning or make your own.

ingredients.name: Crispy tortilla strips
ingredients.notes: To make crispy tortilla strips, cut tortillas into strips and bake in the oven at 350°F (180°C) for 10 minutes.

ingredients.name: Shredded cheese
ingredients.notes: You can use cheddar, Monterey Jack, or a combination of cheeses.

ingredients.name: Diced tomatoes
ingredients.notes: You can use fresh or canned diced tomatoes.

ingredients.name: Diced onion
ingredients.notes: You can use fresh or frozen diced onion.

ingredients.name: Chopped cilantro
ingredients.notes: You can use fresh or dried cilantro.

ingredients.name: Sour cream
ingredients.notes: Optional, but adds a nice tangy flavor to the dish.

ingredients.name: Salsa
ingredients.notes: You can use store-bought or homemade salsa.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use salt to taste, but be mindful of the amount of sodium already present in the taco seasoning and cheese.

instructions: Cook the paccheri pasta according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat. Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the taco seasoning to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the diced tomatoes to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they start to break down.
Stir in the shredded cheese until melted and well combined.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pasta, taco mixture, and crispy tortilla strips. Mix well to combine.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with additional shredded cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving. Garnish with chopped cilantro and a dollop of sour cream, if desired.
